review.notes: Full structure check (no code fences in source; heading set matches the printed sections) plus word-level diff of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 18 physical PDF pages. All words missing from the OCR text were verified to be figure-internal prompt-box/axis content (Figures 2, 4, 7, 14) shown by the embedded images, or the boilerplate footer on page 1. Physical pages 13-14 were rendered at 300 dpi to verify the contributor list spacing and the page-break hyphenation of reference [4]. The two identical '## Thinking Trace from Gemini Robotics ER 2' headings correctly mark two separate worked examples, each preceded by its own figure image.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.13 contributor list tail reads 'Todd McInally, Todor Davchev, Tong Zhao, Travers Rhodes, Tsang-Wei Edward Lee, ...' with a comma+space after every name and the printed spelling 'Travers Rhodes' (visually verified at 300 dpi). OCR dropped the spaces after the last 15 commas and misread 'Travers' as 'Thravers'; the patch only restores the printed spacing and spelling.

Reference [4] is split across the page break in the printed PDF: physical p.13 ends with '...Divya Garikapati, Anirudha Ma-' and physical p.14 starts with 'jumdar, Pierre Sermanet, and Vikas Sindhwani. Can ai perceive physical danger and intervene?' (rendered p.14 top verified at 300 dpi; the same page prints 'Anirudha Majumdar' as one word in reference [5] and in the contributor list on p.13). OCR kept the hyphen and inserted a blank paragraph break; the patch joins the printed name.

unresolved.evidence: Short fragments of text that exists only inside the prompt-box/axis artwork of Figures 2, 4, 7 and 14 (e.g. the '{"humans_detected": ...}' code line, '(%).' axis remnant and '(% Accuracy on adversarial but readable instruments)') remain interleaved as plain text around the embedded figures; they are not headings and the content is already visible in the embedded images, so no text patch is proposed.
